semantic.environment: Production shared services in Node with real OpenRouter vectors, then installed native production Rerank on the exact saved pools; no second paid embedding request.

harness: Initial fresh-profile Restricted mode prevented plugin startup before any paid dispatch; harness now enables community plugins only after verifying the temporary vault.

Delayed key usage initially tripped per-request reconciliation after embeddings. Free regression added; cumulative receipts matched exactly; an append-only reconciliation event cleared the reserve without another embedding call.

verification.lint: PASS: existing api.ts:402 fetch warning only

recommendation.reason: Tied 4/4 top-1 and MRR 1.0, substantially lower measured cost, similar observed latency. No demonstrated improvement over this already-correct semantic baseline.

limitations: Four easy synthetic labelled queries; no statistical superiority or real-vault quality claim.
Fixed cases contain only three documents each, so top-3 is uninformative there.
Semantic corpus contains 12 short notes; all four relevant notes already rank first and all fit in the pool.
UI smoke used synthetic vectors. Real embedding/index quality was evaluated separately through shared production services, not a full native cloud-index UI run.
One response per case/model; request order was not randomized. Latencies include host/network overhead, not provider-only inference.
Required npm validation overlapped the final semantic rerank stage; its latency is not a controlled model-speed comparison.
Linux Obsidian only; no mobile, other OS, custom themes, screen-reader or long-document billing evidence.
No second semantic reranker was needed: the measured baseline already saturated the labels.
